Subject: Re: Q4 surge planning and short-term capacity — technical notes

Elena / Sean —

Quick technical readout after looking at QuantaRetail's last 90 days: overall token mix skewed ~70% short completions (low context) and 30% long-form generation. Latency tail tends to spike at higher concurrency due to KV-cache pressure on large-context models. Recommendations:

- For holiday traffic, route high-frequency short prompts to a smaller-context variant (saves ~20% per-token cost and reduces p95 latency).
- Enable prefix-KV caching for common templates (we estimate ~12–15% token savings).
- If you need consistent p95 targets during surge, add 1-2 reserved GPUs in the pool as burst capacity (we can price as reserve for 3 weeks).

Attached: consumption_breakdown_dec.csv (token counts by model + hourly peaks). I can prepare a two-slide technical appendix for your procurement team showing expected latency/cost delta for the 30% commit + burst credit scenario.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
